_comment: Alt text for the shipped photographs, keyed by public path. Hand-maintained: edit this file, then run `npm run images:manifest`. The generator merges it into lib/data/image-manifest.ts so the media picker can offer the alt text when an editor selects an image. Photographs with no entry here show 'No alt text on file' in the picker, which is honest — an alt describing a photograph of a real participant should be written by someone who has seen it, not generated from a filename.
